propositions: The overlap judge step re-sends the query ticket digest block verbatim in every user message across a batch, consuming full-price input tokens despite identical bytes across calls.

Moving the invariant query digest from the per-call user message into the system prompt makes it part of the cacheable prefix, reducing re-transmission cost if the prefix reaches the model's minimum cacheable threshold.

The measured minimum cacheable prefix for claude-sonnet-4-6 is 1024 tokens, not the 4096 hardcoded for Opus; hoisting yields a 846-token prefix, which falls short and produces a measured +936 token (+5.8%) regression.
Precision is preserved across 12 ordered pairs after the hoist: all relations remain identical, confirming the pointer-for-inline-digest substitution does not degrade judge quality.
A follow-up ticket (c403-cc3a-2c6d-4b9d) batches candidates per call to close the 149–296 token gap and push the prefix past 1024, the structural precondition for any caching win at this call site.
